statement: The pinned USB Host Shield XBOXRECV implementation services four receiver input pipes and sends status, LED and rumble to a controller-indexed output pipe. Together with xpad's interface-local context this supports a four-slot host consumer model, but does not prove any specific retail USB configuration or maximum connected count.
